title: FrankenRobotics Provenance-Lift Registry (frob.lifts/1)
description: Registry of files lifted from FrankenSuite sibling repositories under the lift posture (N33a-01, KILL-FSIM fallback (b)). Ships empty and schema-valid at M0.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the lifted file in FrankenRobotics.

source_path.description: Repository-relative path inside source_repo; never an absolute or home-directory path.

source_rev.description: 40 lower-case hexadecimal git commit SHA of source_repo.

source_hash.description: 64 lower-case hexadecimal BLAKE3 digest of the source file bytes at source_rev.

lifted_hash.description: 64 lower-case hexadecimal BLAKE3 digest of the file as lifted, before any local edit.

golden_test.description: Repository-relative path of the golden test pinning behaviour captured at source_rev.

reason.description: Decision or kill-gate fallback authorizing the lift (e.g. KILL-FSIM fallback (b)).

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the lift was recorded.
